ownerRole: Registry maintainer; not the copyright owner of third-party assets.
scope: Application UI assets only; project materials and generated content are excluded.

assets.usage: Semantic UI icons; consumers use the shared icon map rather than copying SVG paths.
Application interface typography with the declared CJK system fallbacks.
Authored teaching code and technical surfaces.

newAssetRequirements: Register source, license, owner, usage, local entry and required light/dark variants before use.
For new product assets, record the author or provider, required attribution, permitted modifications and the license evidence; registry maintenance does not imply ownership or extra permissions.
For new product assets, register the original source file, exported variants, applicable resolution or cropping rules, Figma node URL and consuming code locations.
Do not invent missing authorization details for existing dependency assets; keep their declared license and distribution pipeline, and resolve unknown rights before adding new product files.
Keep UI images and marks under this directory; reference a named asset instead of embedding an ad hoc data URL in a business component.
Keep font binaries and their licenses with the declared dependency/build pipeline.
Do not put user uploads, generated teaching assets or credentials in this registry.
